Health data privacy

This research/wellness feature reads only the Health Connect data types shown in the permission dialog: heart rate, resting heart rate, HRV, oxygen saturation, respiratory rate, steps, sleep, active calories, and skin temperature when the device supports it.

Data is used to build time-aligned, non-diagnostic sensor features. It is sent only to the configured Health Guardian HTTPS backend after authentication. Camera frames never leave the device and are not stored; the camera prototype evaluates lighting, blur, clipping, and motion only.

You can deny any permission, pause synchronization, or revoke access in Health Connect at any time. The app does not sell health data, use it for advertising, or make emergency/medical decisions.

The project owner must replace this in-app disclosure with the reviewed public privacy-policy text and URL before Play distribution.
